_comment: How each demo loop is built: the view it is rendered from and the pose@frame keys it runs through. animate.py reads this when given only a slug and an output path, so a shipped loop can be re-made without guessing. ⚠ ONLY SPECS THAT HAVE BEEN RENDERED AND PASSED THE CHECKS BELONG HERE. A guess would be worse than an empty table: the file's whole purpose is to be trusted, and a wrong spec produces a DIFFERENT loop while looking authoritative. A loop with no entry cannot be re-made until its spec is re-derived and verified. See docs/anatomy-renders.md.
